notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR4: ALL PROCEDURES applies GR3 "for every procedure-name in the program, except those appearing within a debugging section". AddAllProceduresSubjects makes every paragraph and every section outside a debugging section a subject (non-debugging USE sections included), each section through AddDebugSectionSubject, which since PB5414 fires only on entry from outside the section. Probed at 85 (classes b, e): S1 and S1-1 START PROGRAM; a loop GO TO S1-1 runs S1-1 twice ([24][S1-1][ ]) and S1 not again; S1-2 FALL THROUGH; PERFORM S2 runs S2 and S2-1 with PERFORM LOOP; GO TO S3 runs S3 and S3-1 with spaces; the debugging section DBG and its paragraph are never subjects; a failed OPEN INPUT (status 35) runs the USE AFTER ERROR section ERR and ERR-P with USE PROCEDURE before IN USE. The witness matches. || REFUTED: PARTIAL (harm: wrong output): under ALL PROCEDURES an empty section is never a subject, so PERFORM of it and fall-through into it run no debugging section.
